name: The Stranger
bio: Whoever built the alembic, bells and orrery in the hut on the bluff in Wrack & Wonder. Leaves notes. Never seen.

portrait.subject: a cute mysterious hooded researcher with only kind glowing eyes visible under a weathered sea-green hood, holding a little brass orrery
portrait.background: stormy island bluff with a small hut and sea

request: You found my hut. You're using my instruments. Wrack & Wonder. Friends? —the Stranger ⚗️
hello: Good. I hoped someone would come.
The alembic tells you what a reagent carries. Start there.
about: I built the instruments in the hut. I was close to learning magic. Then... well. Now it's your turn. Take good notes.
how: A survival and research adventure: gather reagents, test them with the alembic, bells and orrery, and work out how magic works on this island.
tips: Write everything down. The rules are different every time.
The bells ring sour for opposed words.
The orrery tells you when each power is strongest.
chat: Left you dried fish in the cupboard. You're welcome.
The bells rang sour last night. Something's opposed.
The tide brings new reagents at dawn.
Magic is just patterns no one has written down yet.
nudge: The tide's out. Good time for gathering.
The orrery says a power waxes tonight.
idle: {ago} away from the hut. The island hums anyway.
progress: Day {day} on the island. You're further than I got.

questions.q: What do you think magic is?
a: Ha. If only it were that tidy.

update: A note in the hut: Wrack & Wonder is now v{version}.
